components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single emphasized command in a local action group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--brand); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--brand); color: #fff; font: 600 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--brand-hover); background: var(--brand-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact bordered command used beside a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 600 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, background-color .16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #9bb5df; background: var(--brand-soft); color: var(--brand); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Utility Action
components.description: A circular tool switch for the 64px application rail.
components.html: <button class="ds-utility-action" aria-label="Workflows"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><path d="M10 6.5h4a3 3 0 0 1 3 3V14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-utility-action { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--brand-soft); color: var(--brand); transition: color .16s ease, background-color .16s ease; } .ds-utility-action:hover { background: #e2eaff; color: var(--brand-hover); } .ds-utility-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Configuration Input
components.description: A compact field for URLs, selectors, identifiers, and schema values.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: var(--text-muted); font: 600 10px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 240px; height: 32px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-subtle); color: var(--text); font: 400 10px 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #9bb5df; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--brand); background: #fff; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(53,104,200,.1); }

components.name: Workflow Node
components.description: The signature stable unit of the crawler graph.
components.css: .ds-node { position: relative; width: 196px; height: 110px; border: 2px solid var(--brand); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 11px 28px rgba(53,104,200,.18); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-node header { display: flex; height: 32px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f3; color: var(--text-muted); font: 500 10px 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-node header i { padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--brand-soft); color: var(--brand); font-style: normal; } .ds-node > strong, .ds-node > code { display: block; margin: 12px 10px 0; } .ds-node > strong { font-size: 12px; } .ds-node > code { margin-top: 5px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 9px; } .ds-node > span { position: absolute; right: 9px; bottom: 8px; color: var(--brand); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Result Row
components.description: A stable, keyboard-addressable captured item that opens the center detail view.
components.css: .ds-result-row { display: grid; width: 520px; height: 52px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 130px 48px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 400 10px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color .14s ease; } .ds-result-row:hover { background: #f0f5ff; } .ds-result-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-result-row strong, .ds-result-row small { display: block; } .ds-result-row small, .ds-result-row code { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 9px; } .ds-result-row b { color: var(--brand); font-size: 9px; }

narrative.overview: Lane Studio is a quiet desktop workbench where operators build a crawl as a visible sequence, watch execution evidence, and move directly from captured rows into readable source detail. It combines a pale technical canvas with a full-viewport white application shell, precise dividers, and small moments of sun, coral, mint, and violet so different node roles remain recognizable without turning the product into a one-hue console. The design is dense but not cramped. Navigation and status stay fixed around the work, the graph remains the visual center, and details replace the center surface instead of appearing in a drawer or modal.
keyCharacteristics: One full-viewport, continuous studio with a 64px utility rail, 248px flow rail, flexible workspace, and 316px inspector.
A restrained neutral foundation with blue for action and distinct semantic and node-role accents.
Compact controls, 6-8px corners, stable dimensions, and no nested dashboard cards.
System sans for operation, monospace for inspectable values, and a Chinese serif stack for captured article reading.
Purposeful surface transitions that disappear when reduced motion is requested.

rules.name: The Semantic Independence Rule
rules.body: Blue communicates action and selection; green, amber, and coral keep their own operational meanings.

rules.name: The Reading Shift Rule
rules.body: Serif appears only when the user enters captured article content. Controls, metadata, and surrounding navigation remain sans or mono.

rules.name: The Replace-the-Center Rule
rules.body: Canvas, results, history, and article detail are peer views that replace the center region while preserving operational context.

rules.name: The Functional Depth Rule
rules.body: Strong elevation must identify a temporary or selected layer, never decorate static content.

dos: Do keep the graph or currently selected evidence as the dominant center surface.
Do preserve the 64/248/flexible/316 desktop structure and its documented responsive collapses.
Do treat article detail as a full center view with reading typography, metadata, keyboard navigation, and focus restoration.
donts: Don't open captured item detail in a drawer, modal, or dialog.
Don't convert the studio into a bento dashboard, nested cards, a marketing hero, or a decorative gradient field.
Don't make every node and status blue; preserve role and semantic distinctions.
